note: Corps campground on a wooded hillside at the north end of Clearwater Dam, three loops stepping down to the lake with the marina, boat ramp and swim beach along the shore below. Loop C's sites 13 and 14 sit on the open bank outside the loop road and 10-12 look over it to the water; loop A's sites 14-16 are just above the swim beach; most of the rest are in timber up the slope. Two camping units and 10 people per site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed open and bookable on recreation.gov: 80 RV sites, all electric (30 amp $16; 22 at 50 amp with water $20), shortest 35 ft, showers and dump. Reservation season Apr 1-Oct 30; off-season status unread. Lake is in open view from named sites - lakeview holds, with two pads on the bank (upgrade lead). Pin is inside loop B, fine. No phone stored.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, holds; upgrade lead): with the catalog coordinates plotted on leaf-off imagery, loop C sites C13 and C14 are on the open lake bank outside the loop road, about 20-25 m from the water with nothing between (both 30-amp RV sites, 50 and 100 ft). C10, C11 and C12 are on the inner side of that road 40-60 m from the water over an open bank. Loop A sites A14, A15 and A16 are 40-70 m above the swim beach (day use between). Loop B and the rest of A and C are in timber 100-350 m up the slope. So the lake is plainly in view from at least eight named sites, and two pads (C13, C14) meet the 50 m open-apron test. Owner's call whether two of 80 make it lakefront; I left lakeview. rec.gov tags no site with Proximity to Water.

SITE COUNT: stored 97 (the description's figure). The catalog has 96 records: 80 RV-capable electric sites, 11 non-electric sites whose permitted equipment is Tent only, 2 electric tent/pop-up sites, 1 group site and 2 day-use shelters. Wrote 80.

HOOKUPS: stored water true is right for only 24 of the 80 RV sites (the $20 ones); the other 56 are electric only. Kept true with the split in fees.note. No sewer anywhere (written false; dump station on site).

SEASON not written; FCFS unconfirmed: the rate table is a single Peak season April 1-October 30 every year through 2028, and the calendar returns no availability rows at all for November and March and bookable sites from April 1 (26 of 96 show Closed in April 2027). Nothing on recreation.gov says whether the loops are open walk-up from November to March; the stored booking.fcfs 'after_cutoff' and the note's 'FCFS off-peak' are unconfirmed, and I removed the phrase from the note. The Corps' own lake page was not read (the notice only links to it).
PHONE: none stored. recreation.gov gives 573-223-4432 (Piedmont Park gate house) and 573-223-7777 (Clearwater Lake project office). Suggest the project office number, which is answered year-round.
